meta.title: tech community for developers and companies
meta.description: Spanish-speaking Discord community where developers and tech companies meet before a job opens. Publish your profile, join tournaments and let them find you.
meta.ogAlt: TechToJob: Spanish-speaking community of developers and tech companies

hero.title: The tech community where <mark>people know you</mark> before the job opens
hero.subtitle: TechToJob brings developers, data, security and design people together with the companies that hire them, in one Discord. You build, you take part, and people see how you work. When someone is hiring, they already know who you are.
hero.note: Free for candidates. You join with your Discord account.

contrast.portalText: You send a CV. You compete with hundreds. Nobody replies.
contrast.hereText: You are inside. You show what you do. They message you.

howItWorks.title: From joining the server to getting a message, <mark>in four steps</mark>
howItWorks.subtitle: Getting started takes one click. The rest comes from taking part, not from filling in forms.

steps.title: You join the Discord
steps.text: With your Discord account and that is it. No ten-screen sign-up, no PDF CV.

steps.title: You introduce yourself and pick your channels
steps.text: You say what you do, your level and what you are after. You follow the channels for your area.

steps.title: You take part
steps.text: You answer a question, enter a tournament, show what you are building. People start to know who you are.

steps.title: An opportunity shows up
steps.text: A company needs someone like you, someone recommends you, or they message you directly. Not because of a CV: because they have seen you work.

talent.title: Let them message <mark>you</mark>
talent.text: Publish your profile with your stack, your level and when you can start. Companies in the server check it when they are hiring and send you a direct message.

points.title: Nobody rejects you before reading you
points.text: There is no automatic filter. A person reads your profile, not a system scanning for keywords.

points.title: You do not need to be senior
points.text: Junior, switching careers or with your first finished project. Say what you can do and what you want to learn.

points.title: It costs you nothing
points.text: Publishing your profile and talking to companies is free. Now and when you get hired.

companies.title: Hire people you have <mark>already seen work</mark>
companies.text: Post what you need and browse profiles by stack, level and availability. What changes is everything else: here you see how that person answers questions, what they ship in a tournament and how they work with others. Less blind screening. More real context.

points.title: Post your job
points.text: A jobs channel read by the whole community: several areas, several levels, Spain and Latin America.

points.title: Browse profiles with context
points.text: Filter by area, level and availability. And look at what that person has done inside the server.

points.title: Talk directly
points.text: You message whoever interests you. No middlemen, no forms nobody reads.

tournaments.title: Build something real and <mark>have it to show</mark>
tournaments.text: Each tournament is a challenge with a brief, a deadline and a jury with public criteria. The winning entry gets used for real. This very website came out of one.

benefits.title: You learn with a goal
benefits.text: A real brief, a date and a rubric. You learn more than with a tutorial.

benefits.title: You have something to talk about in an interview
benefits.text: A finished project, with a public repo, that anyone can open and see.

benefits.title: You get seen
benefits.text: Companies in the community look at the entries. The winner's credit stays visible.

networking.title: Good jobs are not found. <mark>You hear about them.</mark>
networking.text: Channels by area with people who work in the industry. Questions answered in minutes. And jobs someone shares because they know who is hiring. This is where you hear about them.

newsletter.title: This week's jobs and tournaments, <mark>in your inbox</mark>
newsletter.text: One email every Monday: new jobs from the server, tournaments opening and two or three things from the industry worth your time. Nothing else.
newsletter.privacy: No spam. Unsubscribe in one click.

closing.title: If you have read this far, <mark>you already know</mark> if this is for you
closing.text: Join, introduce yourself and look at what is being built. If it is not for you, you leave. If it is, you are already inside before the next job opens.
